title: VC ka paisa lu ya bootstrapped rahu?
decision: Profitable D2C snacks brand: ₹8 crore VC lekar metros aur quick commerce, ya bootstrapped Tier-2 growth?

kamath.reason: Bootstrap vs VC unka pillar hai

brief: ₹40 lakh per month ka profitable D2C snacks brand, 70% Tier-2 sales, family ka ₹50 lakh loan. VC ₹8 crore offer kar raha hai ₹40 crore valuation pe. Paisa lekar metros aur quick commerce, ya bootstrapped Tier-2 growth, ya beech ka raasta.
assumptions: Family loan ki fixed date nahi (assumed)
